ROW.COLUMN: (FR/EE) Suspicious Transactions Linked to Employee: Same or Similar Amounts

This scenario detects an account or employee that performs a sequence of withdrawal and deposit of cash transactions in same or similar amounts for a specified look back period. For an employee, activities in accounts either directly controlled (owned) by employees, or accounts that are controlled by employee family members are considered by this scenario.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @BUSINESS@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)
SELECT a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, a.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.EMP_ACCT_SEQ_ID FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT a inner join @BUSINESS@.EMP_ACCT b on (a.ACCT_INTRL_ID=b.ACCT_INTRL_ID)

select case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then add_months(add_days(kc.CLNDR_DT, 1), 120) -- 10 years after the current date when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then add_months(kc.CLNDR_DT, -120) end DDATE, -- 10 years before the current date case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '246060999' -- slightly higher than highest possible time string when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '000000000' end DTIME, -- This field was set to type 'Time' in dataset editor, but treated like a string case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then '~' -- printable character with highest ASCII value when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then '!' end DSTRING, -- printable character with lowest ASCII value case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 999999999 -- 9 digits maximum for INT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0 end DINT, case when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 1 then 9999999999999999 -- 16 digits maximum for FLOAT when kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 then 0.0 end DFLOAT, kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal kc where kc.CLNDR_DAY_AGE in (0,1) AND kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL'

-- Primary Rule to retrieve all the employee account who have done the cash transaction SELECT E.EMP_INTRL_ID, E.EMP_SEQ_ID,MAX(ACCT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB)MAX_EFCTV_RISK_NB, (SELECT MAX(CAL.CLNDR_DT) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) CURR_DT, MAX(CASH.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB , COUNT(distinct CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID)CNT_ACCT, -1 D_INT FROM @BUSINESS@.ACCT ACCT INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CASH ON ACCT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP N ON CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID = N.ACCT_INTRL_ID INNER JOIN @BUSINESS@.EMP E ON E.EMP_INTRL_ID = N.EMP_INTRL_ID WHERE CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) --INCLUDE CUSTOMER RETAIL ACCOUNTS ONLY AND ACCT.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' --EXCLUDE EXEMPT ACCOUNTS AND ACCT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 AND ACCT.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN (@oracle_bus_acct_type_lst) AND CASH.DBT_CDT_CD = @Credit_dbt_cd AND CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT > (SELECT ADD_DAYS(CAL.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) AND CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (SELECT CAL.CLNDR_DT FROM @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL WHERE CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm) -- Exclude Cancelled Transaction AND CASH.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --EXCLUDE CASH TRANSACTIONS BETWEEN RELATED PARTIES AND (@Incl_Rltd_Parties = 'Y' OR COALESCE(CASH.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL, 'Y') <> 'N') AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CASH.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_trans_src_lst)) AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR ACCT.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_jurisdictions_lst)) GROUP BY E.EMP_INTRL_ID,E.EMP_SEQ_ID HAVING COUNT(distinct CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID) >= @Min_Acct_Ct

SELECT B.EMP_INTRL_ID D_EMP_ID, CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM D_TRXN_BASE_AMT, CASH.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, F_TO_NUMBER(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CAL.CLNDR_DT, 'J')) D_CLNDR_DT, F_TO_NUMBER(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(CASH.DATA_DUMP_DT, 'J')) D_DATA_DUMP_DT, (CASE WHEN CASH.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > 0 OR CASH.CASH_TRXN_NTITY_RISK_NB > 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) D_HR_TRXN_AM, 0 D_PASS_THRU_TRXN_AM, (CASE WHEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN CASH.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(CASH.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 THEN CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM ELSE 0 END) D_LRF_TRXN_AM
FROM @BUSINESS@.CASH_TRXN CASH, @MINER@.DSVIEW118745039 B, @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP N, @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL CAL
WHERE B.EMP_INTRL_ID = N.EMP_INTRL_ID AND CASH.ACCT_INTRL_ID = N.ACCT_INTRL_ID -- Include cash transaction product types AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD IN (@Incl_Cash_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) -- Include Credit or Debit transaction AND CASH.DBT_CDT_CD = @Credit_dbt_cd -- Individual Transaction Amount greater than or equal to Min Indiv Trans Amt AND ( (B.MAX_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND B.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @HR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) OR (B.MAX_EFCTV_RISK_NB < @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND B.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl AND CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @RR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) OR (CASH.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @MR_Min_Indiv_Trans_Amt) ) --EXCLUDE CASH TRANSACTIONS BETWEEN RELATED PARTIES AND (@Incl_Rltd_Parties = 'Y' OR COALESCE(CASH.UNRLTD_PARTY_FL, 'Y') <> 'N') AND CASH.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > ADD_DAYS(CAL.CLNDR_DT, -@Lookback_Period) AND CASH.TRXN_EXCTN_DT <= CAL.CLNDR_DT AND CAL.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 AND CAL.CLNDR_NM = @Caldr_Nm -- Exclude cancelled transaction AND CASH.CXL_PAIR_TRXN_INTRL_ID IS NULL -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-of-Account Transactions AND CASH.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' AND (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' OR CASH.SRC_SYS_CD IN (@Incl_trans_src_lst))
